en.seoDescription: Yoga retreats with Lucía Cativa. Vinyasa, nature and disconnection in unique settings.
en.title: Retreats
en.intro: A few days to step out of the routine, move your body and reconnect with what is simple. Every retreat is its own encounter, in a place chosen for switching off.
en.empty: There are no open retreats right now. Write to me and I'll let you know when the next one opens.
